description: This file defines a Drupal Twig extension class 'ComponentsTwigExtension' that integrates custom component handling into Twig templates, including context addition and validation functions.

classes.name: ComponentsTwigExtension
classes.description: A final class extending Twig's AbstractExtension to add custom component-related functions and node visitors for Drupal.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing plugin manager and component validator dependencies.

methods.name: getNodeVisitors
methods.description: Returns an array with a new ComponentNodeVisitor instance for Twig node visiting.

methods.name: getFunctions
methods.description: Returns an array of Twig functions for adding component context and validation.

methods.name: addAdditionalContext
methods.description: Adds extra context to a component based on its ID by merging additional render context.

methods.name: mergeAdditionalRenderContext
methods.description: Calculates and merges additional attributes and metadata into the component's rendering context.

methods.name: validateProps
methods.description: Validates component properties in development environments, asserting the validation result.

methods.name: doValidateProps
methods.description: Performs actual validation of component props, catching exceptions if the component is not found.
